svg.title: brainspresso workflow
svg.desc: Harvest downloads source data into sourcedata/, roast converts it to a raw BIDS dataset in rawbids/, grind preprocesses it into derivatives/. Roast and grind can save a plan with --plan; bx percolate PLAN runs its tasks locally or as Slurm, SGE or PBS jobs.
svg.text: From a public dataset to preprocessed derivatives, one command per step.
